text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('conf').glob('*.yaml')):
    data = p.read_text()
    lines = data.splitlines(keepends=True)
    old = 'log_level: debug'
    new = 'log_level: info'
    changed = 0
    out_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.rstrip('\r\n') == old:
            changed += 1
            line = line.replace(old, new, 1)
        out_lines.append(line)
    if changed != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: expected 1 match, found {changed}')
    p.write_text(''.join(out_lines))
    print(f'{p}: changed {changed} line(s)')
PY
